guarantees.claim: When msg_strb == 7'b000_0001, funcpad_data[0] = {56'h0, msg_buf[0][7:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 55'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][7:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_0011, funcpad_data[0] = {48'h0, msg_buf[0][15:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 47'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][15:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_0111, funcpad_data[0] = {40'h0, msg_buf[0][23:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 39'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][23:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {32'h0, msg_buf[0][31:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 31'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][31:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b001_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {24'h0, msg_buf[0][39:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 23'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][39:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b011_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {16'h0, msg_buf[0][47:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 15'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][47:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b111_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {8'h0, msg_buf[0][55:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 7'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][55:0]}.
For any other value of msg_strb not matching the enumerated cases, funcpad_data[0] = 64'd0 and funcpad_data[1] = 64'd0.
guarantees.cond: msg_strb any value other than those listed

assumptions.claim: msg_strb must be one of the specific contiguous right-aligned one patterns (7'b000_0000 through 7'b111_1111) for funcpad_data to receive correct padding data; any other value causes all-zero padding.
assumptions.cond: Always during operation of this padding logic
assumptions.risk: If a hardware fault or FSM error drives an unexpected msg_strb value, the padding block silently outputs zero data, which may be fed into the SHA3 core, corrupting the digest and breaking integrity/security.

assumptions.claim: The inputs msg_buf[0], msg_buf[1], end_of_block, and funcpad must be stable and valid during the entire combinational evaluation of this block.
assumptions.cond: Whenever this combinational logic is used to drive funcpad_data
assumptions.risk: If these inputs change transiently while the output is sampled downstream, incorrect padding data could be latched, causing a functional error in the SHA3 padding.

uncertain_points.claim: The default case forces funcpad_data to all zeros without signaling any error. If msg_strb takes an unexpected value due to a bug or glitch, the resulting zero padding block may be accepted by the SHA3 core, leading to undetectable digest corruption.
uncertain_points.cond: msg_strb takes any value other than the enumerated patterns
uncertain_points.risk: Silent corruption of the SHA3 digest, potentially breaking security critical applications that rely on integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: The validity of msg_strb (constrained to the specific mask patterns) is fully dependent on the upstream module that drives it. There is no assertion or safety check in this chunk to verify the pattern or flag a violation.
uncertain_points.cond: Always when this padding logic is integrated
uncertain_points.risk: If the upstream module fails to enforce the pattern, this chunk silently uses the illegal pattern via the default case, causing a fault that propagates into the SHA3 core undetected.

uncertain_points.claim: The mapping from msg_strb to the number of valid message bytes taken from msg_buf is not explicitly documented. The design appears to take N bytes per 64-bit word where N is the number of trailing 1 bits in msg_strb, but this is left implicit and may cause misinterpretation during integration or verification.
uncertain_points.cond: When interpreting the meaning of msg_strb and the derived byte counts
uncertain_points.risk: Misunderstanding of the padding granularity could lead to integration errors or ineffective security testing.
